comparator.name: Humanistic Studies
comparator.sourceNotes: The current programme page confirms a Dutch-language, full-time degree lasting three years, with 180 EC in total and 60 EC per year. The public 2026–2027 catalogue lists eight first-year courses worth 60 EC. The later years include an unnamed 7.5-EC course (code 0000), Psychology and Embodied Meaning entries assigned to different years, a 15-EC thesis and 30 EC of external study or electives alongside other third-year courses. The catalogue does not establish which entries apply to each entrant cohort or how the choices fit together. The 2025 accreditation report describes the earlier 10-EC thesis and 15-EC elective space and a planned curriculum revision. It does not establish the revised bachelor allocation. The verified first year is retained while the remaining requirements are clarified.

audience.programmeDescription: Humanistic Studies examines meaning-making and how organisations and society can become more humane. It combines philosophy, psychology, sociology, history and worldview studies with research and reflective professional skills.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The revised course sequence and choice requirements remain unconfirmed. The verified first-year courses are shown below. A complete external curriculum is needed before the proposed UCR study compositions can be compared with the degree.
